# DMXOPL (GENMIDI.op2)

`GENMIDI.op2` and `LICENSE` from https://github.com/sneakernets/DMXOPL (the GENMIDI bank "DMXOPL",
by sneakernets / Sneakernets, MIT licence; commit 50cc9336bc, 2018-01-02), unmodified, sha256
`d3feb807e5102d7de3075c2351cced7e853ba2da8708eff98cc1c8ef8f240ce2`.

A General MIDI instrument bank for OPL2 / OPL3 FM chips in DMX's OP2 format (175 instruments: 128
melodic, 47 percussion). C-Bricks copies it beside an MS-DOS program that plays MIDI music
(`audio/genmidi.op2`), where the FM player turns notes into the chip's registers with it. A project
can use its own bank instead: a file named `genmidi.op2` anywhere in the project.
